purpose: Primary-source checks for specialized Book 3 illustration cues.

sources.checked_cues: Underwater speargun silhouette with slender sealed barrel and ergonomic molded grip; lesson translation means a fishing gun, not a hand-thrown spear.
Eight planets in ordered increasing orbits; schematic sizes and spacing.
Opaque cloud-covered pale yellow-white appearance; no Earth-like visible oceans.
Rust-red rocky surface and pale polar cap.
Alternating cloud bands and Great Red Spot, no solid surface.
Sun belongs at one focus of ellipse; repaired artwork uses top-down circular special case with central Sun.
